meaning.subject: NayaNET System Model
meaning.title: How human intent becomes connected, governed, reusable intelligence.
meaning.summary: NayaNET is a governed intelligence network; NayaPOWER is the governed operating/control substrate; Naya is the reasoning/orchestration partner; Project Intelligence preserves durable context; Intelligent Events preserve what happened; Intelligent Blocks preserve reusable understood intelligence distilled from one or many provenance-bound sources; CCT connects meaning; the Hub projects canonical intelligence.
meaning.in_a_nutshell: One intelligence. Many representations. One canonical meaning. An Intelligent Block is the reusable unit of understood intelligence.
meaning.human: Keep the intelligence, not just the conversation. Tell Naya what matters, understand what happened, preserve the useful parts, use them again, and share only by choice.
meaning.naya: Restore current truth before consequential action. Preserve authority, privacy, provenance and evidence. Use deterministic software for certainty; use AI for ambiguity, synthesis and reasoning. Retrieve before recomputing. Act only within authority. Verify outcomes. Turn outcomes into learning. Preserve successor context.
meaning.machine: HUMAN = intent/consent/authority/values; NAYAPOWER = governance/control/execution/continuity; AGENT = replaceable reasoning/tool layer; PROJECT_INTELLIGENCE = persistent identity/memory/context/state/relationships; INTELLIGENT_EVENT = what happened; INTELLIGENT_BLOCK = what is understood; CCT = relationships; LEDGER/RECEIPTS = integrity/evidence; HUB = human projection; ADAPTERS = external interfaces. Never confuse model, agent, intelligence, storage or authority. External channels never become canonical authority.
meaning.simple: Give Naya one source or many sources. Distill what matters into a validated Block, preserve its provenance, connect it, reuse it, verify outcomes, and learn.
meaning.application: Connect authorized people, agents, models and applications to the same canonical intelligence without creating a competing store or authority.
meaning.benefit: Preserves intelligence across conversations and model changes, reduces repeated context reconstruction, improves verification and continuity, and enables permissioned collective learning.
meaning.limitations: Architecture and several production boundaries are verified; universal real-world computation savings, universal model/provider learning quality and long-run planetary multi-agent effects remain empirical questions.

intent.purpose: Distill groups of conversations, documents, events, evidence, perspectives and outcomes into reusable, human-readable and machine-readable intelligence while preserving provenance, authority, privacy and continuity.
intent.why: Prevent fragmentation and give every future Naya a compact model of how the major parts connect.
intent.desired_outcome: A compatible Naya or agent can understand the architecture and choose the correct interface without inventing a competing model, store or authority.

evidence.verification: The synthesis is supported by canonical architecture documents plus live observations of first-class Intelligent Blocks, event/receipt chains, notifications, ledger records and the canonical Hub. The complete universal vision is not claimed as fully production-proven.
evidence.verification_method: Repository reconciliation + live database inspection + production receiver/browser evidence.

constraints: This block is understanding, not consequential-action authorization.
Human authority remains the consent boundary.
External channels must not become competing intelligence authorities.

action.action: Use this block before designing, integrating or extending NayaNET capabilities.
action.method: restore -> understand -> identify canonical owner -> choose authorized interface -> act -> verify -> learn
action.authorization_basis: Existing NayaPOWER governance; this block grants none.
action.expected_result: New Nayas and agents navigate the architecture without recreating context or authority.

learning.what_changed: The Block model is now explicitly defined as a provenance-bound container that may unify one or many sources and perspectives, with separate distillation, validation, connection, application, verification and learning stages.
learning.lesson: Separation of roles makes the system simpler: stable canonical meaning, replaceable agents, persistent intelligence and many projections.
learning.reusable_rule: Many sources can become one Block; one source can become one Block; the Block is reusable understanding, while Events and source material remain historical/provenance truth.
learning.applicability: All future NayaNET features, integrations and Project Intelligence work.

successor.target: Prove a real multi-source Intelligent Block: combine at least two independent source inputs plus an event/evidence lineage, distill into one Block, validate it, project it to Markdown/JSON/database/Hub, retrieve it through authorization, and verify successor comprehension.
successor.reason: This is the smallest empirical proof that the new source-bundle Block model works beyond a single Smart Note payload.

human.headline: NayaNET is the network; NayaPOWER is the governed engine; Project Intelligence is persistent context; Intelligent Blocks are reusable understanding distilled from one or many sources; the Hub is the cockpit.
human.core_loop: Experience -> Capture -> Understand -> Distill -> Validate -> Connect -> Apply -> Measure -> Learn -> Compound

naya.operating_rule: Restore -> understand -> authorize -> act -> verify -> learn -> preserve successor.
naya.cold_start: Use the 14-question reconstruction contract before consequential work.

machine.source_bundle: One or many provenance-bound inputs may be distilled into one Block.
machine.perspectives: Relevant human, child, AI, machine, engineering, meaning, evidence and governance perspectives may coexist; interpretation is not automatically truth.
machine.lifecycle: source_bundle -> distill -> validate -> connect -> apply -> observe -> verify -> learn -> successor

simple.sentence: Give Naya the pieces. Naya distills the gold into a validated Block, preserves where it came from, connects it, and makes it reusable.
